text:
elaine.kim: Heads-up: Umbratek wants a 10-day Private POC starting next Monday. Requirements called out: HSM-backed key material, client certs for connector, and ephemeral API keys with IP locks. They also want a one-paragraph pricing line for procurement.

ravi.patel: Clarify: Private control plane with connectors into their AWS VPC, right? That affects whether we sign their CSRs or they bring a CA.

elaine.kim: Yes, private control plane + connectors. They prefer we sign CSRs for the POC but will accept their HSM signing if we trust the CA. FIPS request mentioned.

toni.liu: We support two flows:
- Flow A: Customer BYOK (AWS KMS ARN or HSM-wrapped key). They provide attestation blob and we map KMS for envelope encryption.
- Flow B: Redwood-managed key encrypted under customer-supplied wrapping key (we never see plaintext).
Either flow works for TLS client certs.

toni.liu: For CSR flow (our signing): customer generates key+CSR and uploads via presigned S3 URL we provide. We sign with our POC intermediate and return cert chain. TTL typically 7-14d.

ravi.patel: Example commands we give customers:
```
# generate key + CSR
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out umbratek-connector.key -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096
openssl req -new -key umbratek-connector.key -out umbratek-connector.csr -subj "/CN=umbratek-connector/O=Umbratek"
```
We also provide a presigned PUT url and instructions to name the file `.csr`.

toni.liu: If they insist on HSM signing, require CA cert + attestation doc. We add the CA to our trust store for the POC. Send vendor attestation (CloudHSM/Thales cert bundle).

elaine.kim: API keys: they want ephemeral key scoped to the Umbratek POC org and IP-restricted to their egress. Can we do 14-day TTL and source CIDR?

ravi.patel: Yes — we can issue a scoped API key with expiry and source IP/CIDR restriction for Private. For extra security recommend mTLS + API key. We will also log key use and rotate daily if they ask.

elaine.kim: Procurement wants a 2-line cost note for POC vs prod. Keep it simple.

toni.liu: Two-line estimate to share: 
- POC: small reserved Dedicated pool or burstable infra; typical 2-week POC footnote ~ one GPU-equivalent per day + data transfer & standard support.
- Prod: committed reserved capacity + premium support; price depends on throughput and retention.
DM me if they need numbers.

ravi.patel: Security questionnaire items to add: key rotation cadence, HSM attestation artifacts, CSR signing workflow, CA upload process, and who in their org can request key operations. Also IP allowlist for connector admin endpoints.

elaine.kim: Action items: 1) Ask Umbratek for HSM attestation + preferred BYOK vs wrapped key, 2) Toni to send CSR + upload instructions, 3) Ops to create ephemeral API key with 14d TTL + CIDR lock, 4) Toni/ravi to draft two-line cost blurb.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-21402: "umbratek-poc-private-hsm" assigned to toni.liu. ETA: 36h for presigned upload + initial API key.

elaine.kim: Also check if legal needs an addendum for key handling. I'll loop in procurement once we have the attestation.

ravi.patel: Noted. I'll prepare the CA upload process doc and a minimal attestation checklist to send to the customer.

elaine.kim: Thanks team — I'll update Umbratek and post their attestation when it arrives. :white_check_mark:
